params._comment: F-077 'Der Altar ruft das End' guided camera, played LOCAL (no teleport, skippable) for players within 128 blocks of the sanctum altar while EndArrivalSequence runs the ~50s show; the play anchor is the altar top center, so all positions/lookAts are offsets from it. Staging: t 0-0.16 slow close orbit on the altar (omen suction), t 0.16-0.24 the tremor pull-back as the erupt hits, t 0.24-0.46 the tilt-up ride along the violet pillar toward the rift maw (lookAt climbs 40->300 with the pillar), t 0.46-0.78 the wide crane past the rift while the debris streams pour onto the disc band (the easeInOutQuart leg crosses to the far side for the Totale), t 0.78-1.0 the implosion framing and a slow settle onto the finished sky-disc. Events are deliberately EMPTY: EndArrivalSequence broadcasts all sound/shake/caption beats itself to the WHOLE dimension so free-watching distant players get the identical read (the end_shatter JSON-event pattern would double them for cutscene viewers). LookAt Y-offsets assume the rift ~300-360 blocks above the altar (rift = disc surface 360 + 80 clearance, altar between Y 60 and Y 140 depending on sanctum stage); the framing is intentionally sky-wide so the variance stays invisible.
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end.
